name: local-image
description: Pictures made on this computer, free and private. The PC: stable-diffusion.cpp (one C++ binary, CUDA 12 build; Vulkan without NVIDIA) running Z-Image Turbo as GGUF (Q4_K + Qwen3-4B text encoder, fits 8 GB with CPU offload). The Mac: mflux (MLX) running Z-Image Turbo 4-bit. Once installed, the image specialist and Settings > Creations use it first.
license: stable-diffusion.cpp MIT; mflux MIT; Z-Image Turbo Apache-2.0; Qwen3-4B Apache-2.0
install: Install (here) or: python tools/setup_extras.py local-image. Downloads about 7 GB into harness_data/ (the PC), or pip-installs mflux and fetches about 6 GB with the first picture (the Mac).
